hook.line: After a few days away, Tomás always asks the same thing: what did I miss? Spanish has a handful of phrases for being up to date, and they all share the idea of keeping pace.
hook.es: ¿Estás al tanto de lo que pasó?
hook.en: Are you up to speed on what happened?

examples.es: Tengo que ponerme al día con las noticias.
examples.en: I have to catch up on the news.

examples.es: ¿Estás al tanto de lo que pasó?
examples.en: Are you up to speed on what happened?

examples.es: Mariana me puso al tanto de todo.
examples.en: Mariana brought me up to speed on everything.

examples.es: No estoy al tanto de lo que dijo el senador.
examples.en: I'm not up to speed on what the senator said.

examples.es: Vale nos puso al día con las ventas.
examples.en: Vale caught us up on sales.

rule:
Spanish uses a few small phrases for being up to date:
*ponerse al día con* = to catch up on something.
*estar al tanto de* = to be up to speed on something.
*poner a alguien al tanto de* = to fill someone in.
*mantener a alguien al corriente* = to keep someone posted.

The person goes before the verb (*me puso*, *te mantengo*). After *al tanto* the topic follows with *de*; after *al día* it follows with *con*. The phrases themselves do not change.
smallPrint: Teachers call these fixed collocations: words that natives always put together, so you learn the whole block.

readAndPick.es: Mariana me puso al tanto de todo.
options: I brought Mariana up to speed on everything.
Mariana brought me up to speed on everything.
Mariana is up to speed on everything.
You keep me posted.
I'll keep you posted.
He keeps you posted.

readAndPick.es: No estoy al tanto de lo que dijo el senador.
options: I'm not up to speed on what the senator said.
I'm up to speed on what the senator said.
The senator isn't up to speed on what I said.

readAndPick.es: Vale nos puso al día con las ventas.
options: Vale caught me up on sales.
We caught Vale up on sales.
Vale caught us up on sales.

readAndPick.es: ¿Estás al tanto de lo que pasó?
options: Are you up to speed on what happened?
Is he up to speed on what happened?
Am I up to speed on what happened?
Are you up to speed?
Will you fill me in?
Can I fill you in?

readAndPick.es: Tengo que ponerme al día con las noticias.
options: I have to catch up on the news.
I have to tell you the news.
I have already caught up on the news.

readAndPick.es: Quiero estar al tanto de la reunión.
options: I want to attend the meeting.
I want to cancel the meeting.
I want to be up to speed on the meeting.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *¿Estás ___ tanto de lo que pasó?* (*al* or *en el*) Are you up to speed on what happened?
yourTurn.answer: ¿Estás al tanto de lo que pasó?

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *Mariana me puso al tanto ___ todo.* (*de* or *en*) Mariana brought me up to speed on everything.
yourTurn.answer: Mariana me puso al tanto de todo.
yourTurn.why: After *al tanto* the topic comes with *de*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: I'll keep you posted. (to a friend)
yourTurn.why: *Te* is you, and *mantengo* is I keep.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: I have to catch up on the news.
yourTurn.answer: Tengo que ponerme al día con las noticias.
yourTurn.why: *Me* goes on the end of the infinitive, and *con* gives the topic.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: I'm not up to speed on what the senator said.
yourTurn.answer: No estoy al tanto de lo que dijo el senador.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: Vale caught us up on sales.
yourTurn.answer: Vale nos puso al día con las ventas.
yourTurn.why: *Nos* is us, placed before the verb.

yourTurn.prompt: Change it to ask a friend: *Estoy al tanto de la situación.*
yourTurn.why: Only the verb changes to *estás*, and the question marks frame it.

pitfalls.wrong: Estoy en el tanto de la situación.
pitfalls.right: Estoy al tanto de la situación.
pitfalls.why: Almost. The phrase is *al tanto*, one block.

pitfalls.right: Estoy al tanto de la situación.
pitfalls.why: Almost. You need *de* before the topic.

personal: Think of a subject you want to be up to speed on this week. Say it: *Quiero estar al tanto de…*.
